scope: Subagent routing in on mode, live: Claude Code 2.1.296, main model claude-sonnet-5-5, 2026-10-10, the router from the subagent-routing branch with subagentRouting on.
source: A copy of the router with DEFAULTS.subagentRouting set to on (the profile router.json was left as it was), loaded with experiments/mod-router/spawn-probe as claude -p --model sonnet --setting-sources project,local --plugin-dir <router copy> --plugin-dir experiments/mod-router/spawn-probe, from spawn-probe/cwd. The probe ran beneath the router, so `sent` is the model the router passed on. `store` is the router's record under its subagents:v1:<session id> key afterwards.

findings.routed: L1: Explore (built-in, listed as haiku) was sent claude-haiku-5-5 and ran on it while the parent ran Sonnet.
findings.classified: L2: general-purpose (classify) was sent the classifier's standard pick, claude-sonnet-5-5, with no failure.
findings.pinPassed: L3: the project agent pinned (frontmatter model: sonnet) passed through as unlisted.
findings.explicitPassed: L4: an Agent call with model opus passed through as explicit and ran on Opus.
findings.recorded: The store counts both routed types under on, with core's estimated model priced against the routed one, and the two pass-throughs by reason.
